automod.explain: Four filters that read every chat message. A message a filter catches is deleted. Moderators and you are never filtered.

links.title: Links
links.description: Deletes a message that holds a link. A link on the allowed list passes.

caps.title: Capital letters
caps.description: Deletes a message that is mostly capital letters.
caps.thresholdHelp: A message with this share of capitals or more is deleted.

phrases.title: Banned phrases
phrases.description: Deletes a message that holds one of these phrases, in any letter case.

emotes.title: Emote spam
emotes.description: Deletes a message that holds too many emotes.
emotes.maxHelp: A message with more emotes than this is deleted.
